_comment: Red-flag warning patterns. If matched, triggers urgent safety warning overriding normal differential interpretation.

red_flags.name: Suspected Stroke / Acute Neurological Deficit
red_flags.emergency_message: Immediate emergency attention required (FAST signs detected). Sudden facial drooping, one-sided weakness, or speech impairment may indicate an acute stroke.
red_flags.action: Call emergency services (e.g. 911 / 999 / 112) immediately. Do not drive yourself.

red_flags.name: Suspected Acute Coronary Syndrome (Heart Attack)
red_flags.emergency_message: Possible acute cardiac event. Chest discomfort radiating to jaw, neck, back, or arm, especially with breathlessness or cold sweats, requires immediate evaluation.
red_flags.action: Call emergency medical services immediately. Rest quietly while awaiting help.

red_flags.name: Severe Respiratory Distress / Hypoxemia
red_flags.emergency_message: Severe breathing difficulty, struggle to speak, or cyanosis (bluish lips/face) indicates critical respiratory compromise.
red_flags.action: Seek immediate emergency medical care or call an ambulance immediately.

red_flags.name: Meningeal Irritation / Central Nervous System Infection
red_flags.emergency_message: Combination of stiff neck with fever, confusion, or severe photophobia may indicate acute meningitis.
red_flags.action: Go to the nearest emergency department immediately for urgent clinical examination.

red_flags.name: Thunderclap Headache (Intracranial Hemorrhage)
red_flags.emergency_message: Sudden, excruciating 'worst headache of life' peaking in seconds may suggest subarachnoid hemorrhage.
red_flags.action: Seek immediate emergency room evaluation. Do not delay.

red_flags.name: Gastrointestinal Bleeding
red_flags.emergency_message: Vomiting blood (hematemesis) or black/tarry stools indicates potential active internal gastrointestinal bleeding.
red_flags.action: Proceed to an emergency room or urgent clinical care immediately.

red_flags.name: Suspected Acute Surgical Abdomen (e.g. Appendicitis/Peritonitis)
red_flags.emergency_message: Severe localized abdominal pain with fever or persistent vomiting may signify an acute surgical condition requiring immediate physician assessment.
red_flags.action: Seek urgent medical care without taking strong laxatives or pain relievers that may mask findings.

red_flags.name: Imminent Psychiatric Crisis / Suicidal Ideation
red_flags.emergency_message: Suicidal ideation or self-harm thoughts represent an acute mental health crisis.
red_flags.action: Contact 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (US/Canada), 111 (UK), or your local crisis helpline / emergency department immediately. You are not alone.
